tags.lyrics-eng:
[ar: NoMeansNo]
[ti: Dark Ages]
[al: The Day Everything Became Isolated And Destroyed]
[by: kei]
[id: rx_vinnulsq]

[00:00.00]-------------------------------------------------
[00:15.00]NoMeansNo
[00:35.00]~ Dark Ages ~
[00:50.00]-------------------------------------------------
[00:50.80]
[00:52.43]We are living in the, in the dark ages
[00:55.50]Haven't seen some daylight in what seems ages
[00:58.63]All the information is locked far beyond
[01:01.68]Locked in circuits and bathed in silicon
[01:04.00]
[01:05.07]And we're fast asleep with our dreams seething
[01:08.08]In and though all is still we are still breathing
[01:11.52]But it's him in the dark, he makes me null and void
[01:14.52]But it's him in the dark, I think I'm paranoid
[01:23.67]
[01:55.83]A world of half-truths, what goes unspoken
[01:58.51]Lines of communication are stripped and broken
[02:02.46]And the dark is cold with hands freezing
[02:05.33]But this deep-freeze seems strangely pleasing
[02:07.92]
[02:08.80]And the powr-trippers receive facelifts
[02:11.80]And the button-pushers all work night shifts
[02:14.99]And the misdemeanors seem so ghastly
[02:17.99]While the media punch is so lasting
[02:22.73]
[02:22.75]And the Eastern comrades find out much too late
[02:24.87]And free men are free to subjugate
[02:27.48]Under megashadow, under nine to five
[02:30.68]Still it's self-extinction that keeps us alive
[02:38.93]
[04:00.34]We are living in the, in the dark ages
[04:03.40]Haven't seen some daylight in what seems ages
[04:06.54]All the information is locked far beyond
[04:09.74]Locked in circuits and bathed in silicon
[04:13.80]
[04:15.14]I don't know
[04:24.14]
[04:25.58]Go to sleep
[04:50.70]We are in the dark ages
